title: How Every Ending Is a Beautiful Beginning
coreMove: A deal breaker is a difference you cannot live with without resentment. Once you know which one you face, you can accept it or end things cleanly.

exampleSpecs.domain: Source case: Chris and ADHD-related household chaos
exampleSpecs.audience: Opal and readers facing deal breaker decision
exampleSpecs.stakes: Acceptance means ending the complaint when the whole person is worth the unresolved issue.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show Opal using deal breaker decision in the source case without controlling another person.
